title: Fermented Slovakian Wrap
description: A weeknight-friendly, fermented dish wrapped in a leaf and steamed to perfection. Serve hot with a side of rye bread.

ingredients.name: 1 leaf ( Swiss chard or collard greens)

instructions: Grill the binchotan block at 300°F for 10 minutes to heat it evenly.
Grind 1 tsp of mixed spice, 1 tsp of brown sugar, and 2 tbsp of caraway seeds into a fine powder in a spice grinder.
Cut the onion into thin slices and sauté in a pan with 1 tsp of brown sugar until caramelized.
Mince the garlic and sauté in the same pan until fragrant.
Add the diced red bell pepper to the pan and sauté for 5 minutes.
Grind the caramelized onions, garlic, and red bell pepper into a fine paste using a food processor.
Add the ground pork shoulder, spice mix, vinegar, and coarse salt to the paste and mix well.
Place 1/2 cup of the fermented meat mixture onto the center of the leaf, leaving a 2-inch border around it.
Fold the leaf over the filling to create a tight package and steam for 30 minutes at 375°F.
Let the package cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
